newsitem.title: USA: N. Carolina group backs stadium finance authority.
newsitem.headline: N. Carolina group backs stadium finance authority.

text.p: A North Carolina group representing 27 chambers of commerce in 12 counties has endorsed the creation of a public financing authority to build a major league baseball stadium between Greensboro and Winson-Salem, the News & Record reported Thursday.
The organization, the Triad Chambers Group, said a bill creating the Triad Stadium Authority could be submitted to the legislature as early as next week.

Don Beaver, a businessman who leads the effort to bring a team to the area, has pledged $70 million for stadium construction. Backers said the total cost of the arena would be about $225 million, putting the contribution sought from taxpayers at about $155 million.

Organizers have not decided what kind of tax to propose, but hope to put a financing plan before voters during the summer. The tax would have to raise $15 million a year over 20 years in the 12-county region.
